verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is entirely about Pipedream MCP as a tool-calling layer (agents invoking pre-built API actions on demand, with managed auth and transport handling); it contains no documentation of users defining rule-based triggers or event-driven automations through the MCP interface. The one passing mention of 'triggers' (docs-36, tool counts for the OpenAI app) is just a catalog metric, not evidence of an automation-rule capability exposed to AI-native users via MCP.
